title: Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic properties of polymyxin B in Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae murine infection models.
locator: Results / Pharmacokinetic modelling; Methods / Pharmacokinetic modelling
quote: The PK profile was described by a one-compartment model with first-order absorption.
summary: Mouse SC plasma population PK; dose covariates on apparent clearance and absorption. NONMEM FOCE+I; bootstrap and VPCs reported. CL/F is not absolute CL.
validation: PK/PD translation used existing human PK for PTA; this is not forward prediction of unknown human PK.
data_availability: Published figures / supplement; individual raw records not verified.
code_availability: Executable PK fitting code not verified.
